articles.summary: FIGS, Inc. (NYSE: FIGS), the global leading healthcare apparel brand dedicated to improving the lives of healthcare professionals, today announced it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, after U.S. markets close. FIGS management will host a conference call that day at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET to discuss its financial and business results and outlook. Prior to the call, FIGS will publish a third quarter 2026 financial highlights presentation on its investor relations website at https://ir.wearfigs.com/financials/quarterly-results/default.aspx . FIGS Third Quarter 2026 Earnings and Conference Call Date: Thursday, November 5, 2026 Time: 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET Live Call: US: (833) 461-5787 International: (585) 542-9983 Conference ID: 350861644 Webcast: A live and archived webcast of the conference call can be accessed at https://ir.wearfigs.com/events-and-presentations/events/default.aspx .
